keyFindings.description: From a socket's open until its Authenticated frame the pending sync keeps the previous socket's admission. In ygo's order SyncStep2 and awareness arrive before Authenticated, so a writable tab that reconnects to an issue closed meanwhile stores the editor's own heading-id stamp of a heading written server-side without an id (pmdoc/parse.go:628), pushed into Yjs by the dispatch a peer's awareness triggers. The read-only room refuses it, the prune skips own rows, and the page says '1 edit saved in this browser can't be sent: this document is read-only.' to a person who typed nothing, until a reload. Reproduced (deep-review PROBE D, real editor and transport in ygo's order with a peer; PROBE E without a peer stores nothing), and rerun by the reviewer.

The browser test's checks after the reopen run as soon as the editor is writable and the dot reads connected, read the pending count once, and check a notice that never shows while connected, so it could not have failed at 52159aaf; the unit tests carry that regression.
